items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday and expected to play after hip injury; Levitan notes great to have him back with possible snap limits to monitor.
items.why: Cleared, no designation; Schefter expected to play, Donald OUT opposite.
items.implication: WR1/2 return boosts Rams passing; monitor limits vs Eagles.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN/ACTIVE and good to go after hamstring; Levitan highlights excellent DvP vs Cowboys (inflate WR scoring 7.3%, most in NFL) with Texans implied 7th-most points.
items.why: Full participant, Rapoport/Schefter confirm good to go.
items.implication: Elite WR spot return; start confidently.
items.opportunity: High target share in favorable matchup

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (thigh); ETR lists with AD Mitchell etc.; creates backfield opportunity.
items.implication: Jets RB snaps to backups; handcuff upgrade.

items.text: Mike Evans (ribs) game-time decision per Shanahan; Rapoport notes he intends to play through with padding, has done similar before (brutal but doable). ETR Q.
items.implication: Monitor morning; if out Kittle/others rise (Berry already loves Kittle).

items.text: DeVonta Smith ruled OUT vs Rams with hamstring; ETR/Levitan note Eagles situation worse without Smith, Goedert, Baun.
items.implication: Eagles pass catchers thinned; Hurts/others affected, reverse any prior beneficiaries if he returns later.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ruled OUT Sunday with sprained ankle; Levitan notes this is the moment Jordan Addison truthers waited for, home vs borderline secondary.
items.why: Did not practice, official out; Rapoport/Vikings confirm.
items.implication: Major WR void; Addison primary beneficiary for targets/routes.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (foot) LP-DNP-LP this week, already dealt with cracked rib; ETR QUESTIONABLE.
items.implication: Risky start; Chargers WR depth if limited/out.

items.text: Dallas Goedert listed OUT along with Smith; Levitan flags Eagles missing three key players (Smith/Goedert/Baun) vs Rams.
items.implication: TE void compounds Eagles issues; Kittle or others in matchup benefit indirectly.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow) along with Rachaad White; ETR confirms.
items.implication: Commanders QB change; McLaurin Q compounds.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest); tough first month with lost goal-line to Wilson, pass-downs to Holani, fumbles, plus Charbonnet (ACL) practicing. Eye test positive long-term though; projections updated.
items.implication: Seahawks RB committee further muddied short-term; long-term still positive.

items.text: Lamar Jackson off injury report and ACTIVE/good to go vs Titans.
items.implication: Ravens offense full strength; Flowers still Q.

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches, Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Top-10 play.
Omarion Hampton HATE: RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snaps down to 42% W3 (13% 3rd down); SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
Quinshon Judkins solid 13.8% target share (pace 64 catches) with Sampson out virtually all season vs 8.3% prior; usage-first positive.
items.implication: RB with pass-catch upside elevated ROS.
